corridor_notes: Per a Sichuan tender-notice aggregator (zhiliaobiaoxun.com, tendering entity: CNPC Southwest Oil & Gas Field Co. / Sichuan Chuangang Gas Co., operator Pengzhou Chuangang Gas Co.), the Pengzhou West Line Gas Pipeline runs from '石油彭州输气站（已建）汇管预留41号DN300球阀接管' (a reserved DN300 ball-valve tie-in on the existing CNPC Pengzhou Gas Transmission Station's header) to '插旗村岳家湾德都高速北侧彭州市与都江堰市交界点' (Yuejia Bay, Chaqi Village, on the north side of the Dedu Expressway, at the Pengzhou-Dujiangyan boundary) -- an exact match to GEM's own StartLocation ('CNPC Pengzhou Gas Transmission Station') and EndLocation ('the boundary between Dujiangyan and Pengzhou'). Total length given as 23.76km (GEM's LengthMergedKm is 24.80km -- close, plausibly a route-alignment/rounding difference, not flagged as an error). Pipe is DN250 L245N seamless steel, 4.0MPa design pressure (municipal-grade), 1,000,000 m3/day capacity. Route crosses Shihua Avenue (石化大道), Pengbai Road (彭白路), Jinlong Avenue (金隆大道), Tiangui Road (天桂路), Beigui Road (北桂路), Tuxi River (土溪河, 1x), Tongma River (桐麻河, 5x), a freight railway, a coal conveyor belt, and an asphalt road -- consistent with a route heading roughly west-northwest from the petrochemical-base station area (east Pengzhou, near Tianpeng Subdistrict) to the Dujiangyan boundary (west Pengzhou). Construction tender issued June 2024 (winning bidders Chongqing Xukai Construction Group and Sichuan Jiacheng Construction, contract dated 2024-07-11); a separate environmental-assessment database record (eiage.com, not independently fetchable -- WAF/bot-wall) lists approval 成环审（评）〔2024〕45号 dated 2024-07-18 and a completion date of 2025-03-25.
researcher_notes: Strong corroboration: both GEM's StartLocation and EndLocation are matched almost verbatim by the source's stated route termini, and the source independently confirms the pipeline's status as CNPC-affiliated (operator Pengzhou Chuangang Gas Co., under Sichuan Chuangang Gas Co. and CNPC Southwest Oil & Gas Field). Length is close (23.76km sourced vs GEM's 24.80km) but not exact -- left unflagged as a likely minor route/rounding variance rather than a data defect, since both endpoints and the operator chain match cleanly. GEM's Status ('proposed') is plausibly stale: the tender/construction-award trail (mid-2024) and the eiage.com-listed 2025-03-25 completion date (from an unfetchable/bot-walled source, not independently verified) suggest this pipeline may already be built or under active construction rather than merely proposed -- worth flagging to the researcher assembling the route-creation batch, though not changed here since Status changes are out of scope for this task.
blockers: Neither endpoint resolved to a station/village-specific point in Nominatim -- both are road-name-level proxies (a stretch of Shihua Avenue near the presumed station, and Chaqi Road near the presumed Chaqi Village terminus), not exact facility/village coordinates. The eiage.com environmental-assessment database page (which would give the most authoritative approval/completion details) could not be fetched -- it returned only WAF/auth-token code, not article content -- so its 2025-03-25 completion date and 46.33-million-yuan investment figure are not independently verified and are not cited as refs.
